title: SBS procedure shape
description: The shape a benchmark runner procedure block declares: its record steps in order, the operation each step makes, the sandbox it runs in and whether it is timed. The methodology scaffold reads it to write a new benchmark's steps. Each `operation` must be a key of `contracts/operations.yaml`.

launch.description: `single`: one sandbox; `sequential`: several, one after another; `at_once`: several started together.

id.description: The record step id the trial record carries.

operation.description: The operation the step makes: a key of `contracts/operations.yaml`.

sandbox.description: The sandbox the step runs in: the first, every sandbox after the first, or every sandbox.

timed.description: Whether the step is a timed measurement.

owner.description: Who owns a failure of an untimed step.

clock_reads.description: A command step that reads the sandbox clock.

repeats.description: A timed step a trial makes more than once, once per round or request.

ready_check.description: Only on create and restore steps: whether an untimed ready check follows. Defaults to true for create and false for restore.
